channel.title: The Nevada Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Nevada Independent (thenevadaindependent.com)

item.title: Henderson gana millones en su contrato con ICE, pero podría no ser suficiente para cubrir costos
item.description: Desde 2020, los ingresos provenientes del contrato de la ciudad con ICE se han reducido a casi la mitad. En 2025, generó $3.5 millones gracias a su acuerdo con ICE — una disminución significativa con respecto a los $7.3 millones que generó el contrato en 2020.

item.title: Demócratas acercan a Nevada para ser sede de las primeras primarias presidenciales 2028
item.description: Nevada podría votar antes que los demás, aunque la decisión tardará en llegar. Posibles candidatos presidenciales están tomando nota.

item.title: OPINION: As a new nuclear arms race looms, our atomic veterans still demand justice
item.description: Nevada stands as a warning of what happens when our panic to compete in the nuclear weapons race blinds us from seeing the true human cost.

item.title: Trump call to ‘nationalize’ elections draws bipartisan opposition in Nevada
item.description: The White House did not provide information about which 15 states Trump was referring to. However, a White House official sent The Nevada Independent several data points that indicate one of the states could be Nevada.

item.title: Nevada judge sidelines prediction market ahead of the Super Bowl
item.description: A Carson City judge agreed with state gaming regulators who filed a civil enforcement action against Polymarket’s platform provider. Also, one CEO is bullish on Vegas.

item.title: Llamado de Trump a 'nacionalizar' las elecciones genera oposición bipartidista en Nevada
item.description: No está claro a cuáles estados se refirió el presidente, pero Nevada ha tenido conflictos con la administración Trump acerca de la supervisión electoral.

item.title: Can you get a regular Nevada driver’s license if you’re undocumented?
item.description: Find out in our latest fact brief.

item.title: ‘Blatant special treatment’, Nevada lawmakers raise safety issues with Boring Co.’s Vegas Loop
item.description: Amid accusations of cronyism, staff from Gov. Joe Lombardo’s office and Boring Co. miss a chance to address many environmental issues and violation dismissals.

item.title: A pregnant asylum seeker is free, but says ICE detention upended her life
item.description: Shortly after The Nevada Independent published an article in late January about her detention, Emine was released from ICE detention. Her conversation with The Indy provides a snapshot of what immigration detention is like for pregnant individuals.

item.title: Solicitante de asilo embarazada ya está en libertad; dice que detención de ICE ha afectado su vida
item.description: Además de no haber recibido atención prenatal en la cárcel de Henderson, Emine Ş dice que los meses en detención le han causado daños económicos y emocionales.
